_meta.wfe_definition: OOS Sharpe (stitched multi-fold backtest) / mean(per-fold in-sample Sharpe), capped OOS Sharpe at +/-3.0. See _compute_wfe() in walk_forward_runner.py.
_meta.sharpe_lo_adjusted_definition: Lo (2002) autocorrelation-adjusted annualized Sharpe on result.portfolio_returns, q=cfg.backtest.rebalance_freq_days. See lo_adjusted_sharpe_ratio() in ascent/research/evaluation.py.
_meta.deflated_sharpe_ratio_definition: Bailey & Lopez de Prado (2014) Deflated Sharpe Ratio: probability true Sharpe > 0 after correcting for selection bias across KNOWN_TRIAL_COUNT trials (curated, see ascent/research/deflated_sharpe.py) and non-normal returns (skew/kurtosis of result.portfolio_returns, n_obs=wf_summary['n_days']). SR-variance-across-trials input uses the documented Mertens (2002) fallback -- see deflated_sharpe_ratio() docstring.
